XANDER HOUSE — RESIDENT REVIEWS
Invented review page, saved as text for testing. 41 reviews, newest first.
Every name, date and star count below is fictional.

★★☆☆☆  Priya N. — 2 August 2026 — Former resident
I moved out in July after two years. The flat was never dry. Damp came through the bedroom
wall every winter and by February there was black mould along the skirting and around the
window reveal. I reported it four times. The answer was always that I should open the
windows more. I would not sign again.

★★☆☆☆  Tomas R. — 28 July 2026 — Former resident
Moving out was the best decision I made here. The bathroom had condensation running down
the tiles most mornings and mould kept coming back on the ceiling however often I cleaned
it. Building management sent a man with a tub of paint, twice.

★★★★☆  Ade O. — 21 July 2026 — Current resident
Good flat, good light, and the concierge team are genuinely kind. My only complaint is the
heat network standing charge, which you pay whether you use heating or not.

★☆☆☆☆  Hannah B. — 14 July 2026 — Former resident
I left the building in June. The damp patch in the hallway cupboard grew all through my
tenancy and the smell got into my clothes. My deposit came back in full, so credit where it
is due, but I would not recommend a ground floor flat here to anyone.

★★★☆☆  Marek W. — 2 July 2026 — Current resident
Fine for the price. Lifts break about once a month and the bin store is grim by Sunday. No
damp in my flat, which after reading the other reviews feels like luck.

★★★★★  Chloe D. — 24 June 2026 — Current resident
Reviewed in exchange for a £25 shopping voucher from the on-site team. Lovely building,
lovely people, would recommend to anyone looking in the area.

★★★★☆  Sam T. — 19 June 2026 — Current resident
Two years here. Noise from the main road is real but the glazing handles it. Maintenance
tickets get closed quickly if you chase.

★★☆☆☆  Iona F. — 11 June 2026 — Former resident
Moved out in May. Nothing dramatic, just tired. The washer dryer was replaced with a cheaper
one and the corridor carpet has not been cleaned in three years.

★★★★★  Danny K. — 3 June 2026 — Current resident
Written in exchange for entry into a prize draw run by the leasing office. Great gym, great
staff, five stars.

★★★☆☆  Aisha M. — 30 May 2026 — Current resident
The flat is warm and the windows are big. Downside: scaffolding went up on the north side in
March for cladding works and my living room has been dark since.

★★☆☆☆  Greg P. — 22 May 2026 — Former resident
Gave notice after eight months. Building site next door starts at seven, and on Saturdays
too. I asked before signing and was told the works were finished.

★★★★☆  Lucia V. — 15 May 2026 — Current resident
Second year here. Good management, quick with repairs, and the courtyard is a nice place to
sit. Council tax band D caught me out — budget for it.

★★★★★  Owen S. — 9 May 2026 — Current resident
Nothing to complain about. Clean, safe, close to the station.

★☆☆☆☆  Nadia H. — 30 April 2026 — Former resident
I moved out early and paid to do it. Mould in the bedroom, damp under the window, and a leak
from the flat above that took eleven weeks to fix. Deposit disputed and partly returned
through the scheme adjudication.

★★★☆☆  Ben L. — 24 April 2026 — Current resident
Decent. The heat network means you cannot shop around and the standing charge is £14.80 a
week before you use anything.

★★★★☆  Yusuf A. — 17 April 2026 — Current resident
Friendly concierge, secure entry, parcels always safe. Gym is small at peak times.

★★☆☆☆  Fiona McD. — 8 April 2026 — Former resident
